name: io.github.aitrailblazer/deltasignal-atlas-7
title: DeltaSignal ATLAS-7
description: Real-time financial intelligence for crypto public companies. Native MCP server with composite presets, alpha signals, covenant stress, peer ranking, risk distribution, SEC XBRL fundamentals, and Azure-native audit status.
instructions: Prefer composite MCP presets for common workflows: deltasignal_morning_brief for daily scans, deltasignal_company_report for ticker reports, deltasignal_pressure_board for risk monitoring, deltasignal_alpha_sweep for opportunities, and deltasignal_quick_ticker_check for fast ticker checks. Use deltasignal_daily_changes for compact Daily Monitoring and deltasignal_daily_change_evidence for explicit ticker/CIK proof drilldowns. Use deltasignal_atlas7_audit_status when the user asks whether the full Azure-native 215-issuer ATLAS-7 regression audit is healthy and fresh. First 5 calls are free where supported; paid usage settles via x402 USDC on Base.
